appName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser toolbar and store. Product name: never translate. Must equal BRAND.name in src/lib/brand.ts.

appDescription.message: Open a quick subthread about any highlighted phrase on claude.ai — ask a side question without derailing the conversation.
appDescription.description: One-sentence store/manifest description. Must equal BRAND.shortDescription in src/lib/brand.ts.

toolbarExplain.description: Button in the small toolbar that appears over a text selection. Streams an explanation of the highlight. Keep short.

toolbarAsk.description: Button in the selection toolbar. Opens the popover with a question input. Keep short.

popoverBack.description: Tooltip/accessible name of the arrow button that returns from the history list to the thread.

popoverHistory.description: Header title of the history view and tooltip of the button that opens it.

popoverSettings.description: Tooltip/accessible name of the gear button that opens the extension's settings page.

popoverClose.description: Tooltip/accessible name of the × button that closes the popover.

popoverWaiting.description: Accessible name of the animated dots shown before the first words of an answer arrive.

popoverAskPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the question input when the thread is still empty (first question about the highlight).

popoverFollowUpPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the question input once at least one answer exists.

popoverCopy.description: Footer button: copy the last answer to the clipboard. Keep short.

popoverCopyAnswer.description: Tooltip/accessible name of the Copy button.

popoverCopied.description: Copy button label for 1.5 s after a successful copy.

popoverCopyFailed.description: Copy button label for 1.5 s after the clipboard write failed.

popoverOpenSettings.description: Button under an API-key or credit error that opens the settings page.

errorAuth.description: Error shown in the popover when the API rejects the key or none is configured.

errorCredit.description: Error shown when the user's Anthropic account has no credit balance left.

errorRateLimit.message: Rate limited — try again in a moment
errorRateLimit.description: Error shown when the API returns a rate-limit response.

errorUnreachable.description: Error shown on network failures or server errors from the API.

errorBackgroundWorker.message: Could not reach the extension background worker
errorBackgroundWorker.description: Error shown when the page cannot message the extension's own service worker (e.g. after an update).

errorNoApiKey.description: Error message produced by the background worker when settings hold no API key; visible on the settings page's test result.

errorLostConnection.description: Error when the message channel to the background worker closes mid-answer.

errorNetwork.description: Generic message for a failed network request to the API.

errorRequestStatus.description: Message for an API error response without its own message. $1 is the HTTP status code, e.g. 500.

errorNoBody.description: Message when the API answered without a response stream.

errorStream.description: Message when the API's event stream contains an error event without a message.

historyEmpty.message: No side questions in this conversation yet.
historyEmpty.description: Empty state of the history list for the current claude.ai conversation.

historyDelete.description: Tooltip/accessible name of the × button next to one saved thread.

historyClearConversation.description: Full-width button under the history list that deletes every saved thread of the current conversation.

timeJustNow.description: Relative time in the history list: less than a minute ago.

timeMinutesAgo.description: Relative time: $1 minutes ago, $1 is 1–59. Use an abbreviation that works for any count.

timeHoursAgo.description: Relative time: $1 hours ago, $1 is 1–23. Use an abbreviation that works for any count.

timeYesterday.description: Relative time: about one day ago.

timeDaysAgo.description: Relative time: $1 days ago, $1 is always 2 or more.

optionsTitle.description: Browser tab title of the settings page. $1 is the product name (Subthread).

optionsIntro.message: Answers use your own Anthropic API key. It is stored locally and read only by this extension's background worker.
optionsIntro.description: Introductory note at the top of the settings page, followed by the 'Get an API key' link.

optionsGetKey.description: Link text to the Anthropic console page where API keys are created.

optionsApiKey.description: Label of the API key input.

optionsApiKeyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the API key input: the prefix Anthropic keys start with. Keep as is.

optionsShowKey.description: Button next to the API key input that reveals the key. Keep short.

optionsHideKey.description: Button next to the API key input that masks the key again. Keep short.

optionsModelHaiku.description: Dropdown entry for the default, fastest model. Keep the model name.

optionsModelSonnet.description: Dropdown entry for the larger model. Keep the model name.

optionsContext.description: Label of the slider that sets how much conversation text is sent with each question.

optionsContextLess.description: Label at the left end of the context slider. Keep very short.

optionsContextMore.description: Label at the right end of the context slider. Keep very short.

optionsContextTokens.description: Current slider value. $1 is a formatted number, e.g. 8,000. 'Tokens' is the API's unit of text.

optionsContextHelp.message: How much of the conversation is sent with each side question. More gives better answers on long threads and costs slightly more.
optionsContextHelp.description: Help text under the context slider.

optionsSave.description: Primary button that stores the settings. Keep short.

optionsSaved.description: Confirmation shown next to the Save button for two seconds.

optionsTest.description: Button that sends a tiny request to the API with the saved key.

optionsTesting.description: Label of the test button while the request is running.

optionsTestOk.description: Successful test result. $1 is the model id, e.g. claude-haiku-5-5; the model's reply follows in quotes.

optionsTestSample.description: The model's short reply after a successful test, in the locale's quotation marks. $1 is the reply.

optionsHistory.description: Heading of the settings section about saved side questions.

optionsHistoryCounting.description: Shown while the number of saved threads is being read.

optionsHistoryCountOne.description: Count of saved threads when it is exactly one.

optionsHistoryCountMany.description: Count of saved threads for zero or two and more. $1 is the number.

optionsHistoryLocal.description: Note after the count: history never leaves the device.

optionsClearConfirm.description: Confirmation question shown before clearing the whole history.

optionsClearYes.description: Destructive confirm button for clearing the whole history.

optionsCancel.description: Button that dismisses the clear-history confirmation.

optionsClearAll.description: Button in the History section that starts the clear-everything confirmation.
